purpose: bounded full-reference learning pilot; no public strength claim
evaluation: Initial/final checkpoints on identical development pairs and both seats. Frozen opponents. Independent same-key actor random streams at both endpoints. No evaluation updates.
gate: All six seed/opponent cells must have positive simultaneous Hoeffding lower bounds on paired cutoff-aware improvement; alpha 0.05. Cutoff reward interval [0,1]. Failure to establish improvement is inconclusive, not proof of no learning. Terminal-only value MSE is descriptive and outcome-selection-biased.
data: Official generated R7 train teams for updates and R7 development teams for evaluation. No final team use. Exact ordered-team split, not species/family disjointness.
recovery: Atomic model/Adam/counter checkpoint every complete eight-game cohort. Any error aborts the current stage and retains request evidence. Explicit resume replays uncommitted work with identical seeds; no skipped episodes or added budgets.
model: Unchanged F1 928-feature lossy encoder and 64-unit policy/value model; baseline for later representation and curriculum ablations.
